design_description: CDRH3 SLGSADYAFD (6 subs from trastuzumab). RFD4-Proteina generative. 6 subs. Refold keeps the key interface H-bond BEST OF ALL: residue-103 backbone O to HER2 Lys593 NZ at 2.51 A, tighter than the wild-type control fold (2.63 A); G103A retains the carbonyl that makes the bond. Tyr105 to Phe573 3.22 A (control 3.39 A). StaB-ddG 0.42 kcal/mol (2.0x WT, within assay noise). Cleanest developability scored: 5 liabilities vs wild-type 8. No F104P, no A106W.

CDRH3 WGGRGPYWMD (3 subs from trastuzumab). coworker, enumerated. 3 subs; keeps W99/G103/Y105. Refold holds the key H-bond at 3.48 A and Tyr105-Phe573 at 3.30 A. Best StaB-ddG of the enumerated set, 0.20+-0.16 kcal/mol (1.4x WT, statistically indistinguishable from wild-type).

CDRH3 WGHDGPYWMD (3 subs from trastuzumab). coworker, enumerated. 3 subs; keeps W99/G103/Y105. Refold H-bond 4.07 A, Tyr105-Phe573 2.72 A (tighter than control). Highest coworker-model P(beat trastuzumab), 0.244. StaB-ddG 0.50 kcal/mol (2.3x WT).
CDRH3 WGPDGPYWMD (3 subs from trastuzumab). coworker, enumerated. 3 subs; keeps W99/G103/Y105. Refold H-bond 3.20 A, Tyr105-Phe573 3.03 A. StaB-ddG 0.74 kcal/mol (3.5x WT, within assay noise).
